A wildfire. A night checkpoint. A rocket on the pad.
一场山火。一处夜间检查站。一枚待发射的火箭。
Some of this footage is real.
其中一些画面是真实的。
The rest was generated from a single real frame.
其余的，只由一帧真实画面生成。
So: can we defend against AI-generated videos of real crises?
那么：面对真实危机事件的 AI 生成视频，我们防得住吗？
RA-Bench uses real videos as anchors.
RA-Bench 以真实视频为锚点。
1,830 real clips across ten kinds of crisis
覆盖十类危机的 1,830 段真实片段，
each hand their first frame and a shared caption to nine video generators.
每段都把首帧和同一段描述交给九个视频生成器。
16,056 forgeries that start exactly where reality does.
16,056 段伪造视频，每一段都从现实所在之处开始。
We tested three families of detectors.
我们测试了三类检测器。
Traditional detectors that score up to 98.6 on public benchmarks
在公开基准上最高能达到 98.6 的传统检测器，
fall to near chance.
在这里跌到接近随机。
Zero-shot multimodal models flip their verdicts when the prompt changes.
零样本多模态大模型，换一种提问方式，结论就会翻转。
And a fine-tuned detector was partly reading timestamps.
而一个微调检测器，其实部分在“读时间戳”。
Swap them for frame indices, and its edge disappears.
换成帧序号，它的优势就消失了。
The more real footage a forgery starts from,
伪造视频依据的真实画面越多，
the less fine-tuned detectors flag it: from seventy percent to twenty-eight.
微调检测器标记出的就越少：从 70% 降到 28%。
People are fooled too.
人也会被骗。
633 generated clips were judged real by all five reviewers.
有 633 段生成视频，被全部五位评审判为真实。
On those, even Gemini, the strongest zero-shot model, does little better than a coin flip.
在这些视频上，即使是最强的零样本模型 Gemini，也只比抛硬币好一点。
Then the video gets shared:
接着，视频被转发：
re-encoded, downscaled, badged like the news.
被重新编码、缩小分辨率、加上新闻角标。
Fine-tuned detectors’ fake recall falls from 46 percent to 1.4.
微调检测器的伪造召回率，从 46% 跌到 1.4%。
Detection has to survive the real world.
检测，必须经得起真实世界的考验。
RA-Bench is open. Put your detector to the test.
RA-Bench 已开放。来检验你的检测器吧。
